name: Eventdex
description: Eventdex is an event-management suite for registration, ticketing, event apps, attendee matchmaking, onsite operations, badge printing and lead retrieval.
agentUseSummary: Eventdex is visible as a provider-partnership preview. Relay will not request credentials or expose agent actions until Eventdex supplies a supported multi-customer authorization and API contract.

capabilities.label: Access authorized event data
capabilities.description: After Eventdex approves Relay and documents a supported contract, expose only reviewed event capabilities within the authorized tenant.

blocked.label: Connect before provider partnership
blocked.description: Relay has not received a supported multi-customer authorization or API contract from Eventdex.

blocked.label: Collect login or session credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not collect an Eventdex password, browser cookie or client session as a substitute for supported provider authorization.

blocked.label: Use undocumented endpoints
blocked.description: Relay will not scrape Eventdex dashboards or reverse engineer private event, attendee, registration, payment, badge or lead calls.

blocked.label: Run agent actions before contract review
blocked.description: No event, people, ticketing, payment, matchmaking, lead, check-in or administrative action is callable before contract review.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider partnership required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable until Eventdex supplies supported authorization and API contracts.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until Eventdex approves a supported production integration.
No Hermes tools are callable until Eventdex approves a supported production integration.

providerSetup.blocker: Eventdex's official public material describes integrations and sensitive event workflows but does not publish the authentication, endpoints, schemas, permissions, rate limits, lifecycle or distribution terms required for a Relay connector.
providerSetup.nextAction: Contact Eventdex through its official sales channel and request a written multi-customer authorization and API contract. Review tenant binding, scopes, people and payment fields, limits, revocation and third-party terms before implementing bounded tools.

evidence.supports: Eventdex's official platform flyer describes registration, event apps, check-in, onsite ticket sales, attendee connectivity, matchmaking, lead retrieval and leading integrations, but no public developer contract.

Eventdex's official registration material documents ticketing, payments, attendee data, custom questions, automated check-ins and named payment integrations, reinforcing the need for an explicit scoped contract.
Eventdex's official lead-retrieval material describes scanning, synchronizing and enriching personal lead records without publishing a third-party authorization or API lifecycle.
